content:
I have been constantly on the hunt for ultra-thin accessories to complement my everyday carry (EDC), and I generally pay close attention to how thin tech companies and brands can make their products. I tend to avoid accessories that are too thick or lack organizational features. As a result, I have tried countless accessories, from chargers to stands, magnetic cables, and everything in between. I wanted to share some of my favorites that are not only ultra-thin and portable, but also highly versatile.

Be sure to check out my hands-on video featuring all the devices mentioned and more. The video covers 11 small, slim accessories worth noting!

This is my latest addition to my EDC, and it is genuinely fantastic. The fact that it can do so much while being so thin is mind-blowing. It is basically the same thickness as the iPhone's camera bump. Here are its key features:

  • It features a Popsocket-like grip that can be used with one or two fingers
  • It has a separate, adjustable metal stand that rotates 350 degrees
  • It supports both portrait and landscape viewing
  • It features a magnetic design on both sides, meaning you can stack more MagSafe accessories on top of the stand

I still do not understand how they managed to pack so much functionality into such a thin and light stand, but it has become a permanent fixture on my iPhone. It is so thin that you can wirelessly charge with it attached! And because it is so slim, it even eliminates the wobble when you lay your phone flat on a table!

The Snap Grip Stand is available on their website for $39.99 and comes in four colors: black, green, lilac, and silver. They also offer a grip-only version for $29.99, which is available in 18 colors (too many to count). It is a highly recommended product for any iPhone user.

This is an absolute favorite. On the surface, it looks like just another three-in-one charger for your Apple products, but its build quality, features, and value for money are what truly set it apart. You get:

  • A Qi2.2 25W MagSafe-compatible charger
  • A 5W Apple Watch charger
  • A 5W AirPods charger
  • A foldable CNC aluminum design

This thing is incredibly small, thin, and light. The Kuxiu X40 Turbo can fold up to charge just your iPhone, unfold into a three-in-one charging stand, or lay completely flat. At its thinnest point, it is only 18mm, and it fits comfortably in the palm of your hand when folded. The best part is that it even includes the 45W power adapter needed to support 25W fast charging, along with a hard-shell carrying case to hold everything. This is a truly underrated product.

The Kuxiu X40 Turbo is available on Kuxiu's website for $78 and comes in five colors: gray, black, wood grain, orange, and cherry. It is the first charger that perfectly matches the Cosmic Orange iPhone! For $78, you get the charger, a braided cable, a 45W power adapter, and a carrying case.

Here is where things get even more interesting. I am a massive proponent of ultra-thin magnetic chargers. High-capacity MagSafe chargers have their uses, but if you want to charge your phone on the go, I would much rather opt for a smaller battery cell so I can top up my phone without turning it into a two-pound brick. Currently, the thinnest and lightest MagSafe charger is the SolidSafe Air. You get:

  • 5,000mAh battery capacity
  • An ultra-thin 6.8mm profile
  • Qi2 wireless charging up to 15W
  • USB-C wired output up to 20W
  • The ability to charge two devices simultaneously

I own three of these chargers and carry one with me everywhere I go. My iPhone 17 Pro barely lasts a full day of use, so having one of these is a necessity for me. They are lightweight, feel premium, and come in several nice colors.

The SolidSafe Air 5K is available on BMX's website for $59 and comes in three colors: black, silver, and gold. You can opt for a two-pack or three-pack bundle to save some money. My only request for the next generation is to swap the LED indicator for a small screen, as long as it does not add any thickness!

This is an interesting product for iPhone photography enthusiasts or anyone who likes to travel light but still have enough lighting. The SnapPocket is a small, portable ring light that magnetically snaps onto the back of your phone. It can also flip around so you get excellent fill lighting when using the front-facing camera. You get:

  • 8 built-in LEDs
  • Brightness up to 90 lumens
  • Four adjustable brightness levels
  • A rotatable, MagSafe-compatible design
  • A rechargeable battery with USB-C charging

On paper, the SnapPocket is twice as bright as the iPhone's built-in flash, and it provides a more steady light source, making it especially great for video. As with the other accessories, this one is all about portability and being small. It fits into any pocket or bag, and since it supports MagSafe, it can stay attached to your phone.

The ShiftCam SnapPocket Light is available on Amazon for $33 (using the promo code on the product page). It comes in three colors: black, blue, and gray. It is the perfect gift for anyone looking to step up their iPhone photography game without spending a lot of money or dealing with overly complicated gear.

I have mentioned this one before, but I use it so much that I wanted to bring it up again. Everyone knows SSD prices are getting out of hand, but for now, buying an external SSD is still far cheaper than paying extra for a high-capacity iPhone with more built-in storage. So when I want to record ProRes video, I always turn to my Lexar ES5 SSD. It magnetically attaches to my phone, has a built-in USB-C cable, and lets me record directly to the SSD without taking up any of my iPhone's storage. You get:

  • Read/write speeds up to 2,000MB/s
  • USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 connectivity
  • Direct ProRes recording support up to 4K/120fps
  • An IP65 rating for water and dust resistance, with 3-meter drop protection
  • Up to 4TB of capacity

The form factor is another reason I lean toward this SSD over other brands. It is small and lightweight, and the edges are slightly rounded, making it more comfortable to hold while gripping the phone.

The Lexar ES5 is available on Amazon, starting at $199 for the 1TB version. While it is slightly more expensive than it was a few months ago, it is still significantly cheaper than buying an iPhone with 1TB of internal storage.

Summary

As I mentioned above, be sure to check out my video where I showcase 11 small, slim products I am confident my readers will love. These five are just my favorites picked from the bunch. My philosophy is to keep everything as lightweight as possible, and these accessories fit that bill perfectly. From the ultra-thin and versatile Snap Grip Stand to the incredibly practical Lexar SSD. They all serve their purpose without forcing me to lug around bulky, heavy accessories.

What do you think of these? Have you used them? What are your favorite accessories in this category? Drop them in the comments below and let's discuss.
